title: Lessons from Archives: Strategies for Collecting Sociocultural Data in Machine Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of dataset curation practices (e.g., the WebText dataset scraped from Reddit) by analyzing the source platform's user demographic statistics (such as age, gender, geography, and socioeconomic status) to identify gaps in sociocultural inclusivity.
Conceptual analysis of how laissez-faire, uncurated data collection methods inherently capture and replicate structural and empirical societal inequities present in the real world.
